question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

31 ÷ 48 × 7 – 322 + 23 = 353
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. ÷ and +.

Given equation: 31 ÷ 48 × 7 – 322 + 23 = 353

Option 1: ÷ and +

After interchanging the expression becomes:

31 + 48 × 7 – 322 ÷ 23 = 353

31 + 48 × 7 – 14

31 + 336 – 14

367 - 14

353 = 353
question_hi:
दिए गए समीकरण को सही बनाने के लिए किन दो चिह्नों को आपस में बदला जाना चाहिए?

31 ÷ 48 × 7 – 322 + 23 = 353
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् ÷ और + है।

दिया गया समीकरण: 31 ÷ 48 × 7 – 322 + 23 = 353

विकल्प 1: ÷ और +आपस में बदलने के बाद व्यंजक बन जाता है:

31 + 48 × 7 – 322 ÷ 23 = 353

31 + 48 × 7 – 14

31 + 336 – 14

367 - 14

353 = 353

question:
Which two mathematical signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. ÷ and ×.

After putting the signs in Option 1 the equation is satisfied

101 - 25 = 76

76 = 76

question:
If ‘+’ means ‘×’, ‘–’ means ‘÷’, ‘×’ means ‘+’, and ‘÷’ means ‘−’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

42 × 168 - 8 ÷ 4 + 3 = ?
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 51.

Given Equation : 42 × 168 - 8 ÷ 4 + 3 = ?

After putting the correct sign the equation becomes:

= 42 + 168 ÷ 8 - 4 × 3 ( Using BODMAS)

= 42 + 21 - 4 × 3

= 42 + 21 - 12

= 63 - 12 = 51

= 42 + 168 ÷ 8 - 4 × 3 (BODMAS का उपयोग करके)

= 42 + 21 - 4 × 3

= 42 + 21 - 12

= 63 - 12 = 51

question:
If ‘+’ means ‘divided by’, ‘ ̶ ’ means ‘added to’, ‘×’ means ‘subtracted from’, and ‘÷’ means ‘multiplied by’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

[{(23 × 15) - (2 ÷ 2)} + (2 - 4)] ÷ 2
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 4.

Given conditions: ‘+’ means ‘divided by’, ‘ ̶ ’ means ‘added to’, ‘×’ means ‘subtracted from’, and ‘÷’ means ‘multiplied by’

Given equation: [{(23 × 15) - (2 ÷ 2)} + (2 - 4)] ÷ 2

After interchanging the expression becomes:

= [{(23 - 15) + (2 × 2)} ÷ (2 + 4)] × 2

= [{8 + 4} ÷ 6] × 2

= [12 ÷ 6] × 2

= 2 × 2 = 4
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 4 है।

दी गई शर्तें: '+' का अर्थ 'विभाजित करना' है, '-' का अर्थ 'जोड़ना' है, '×' का अर्थ 'घटाना' है, और '÷' का अर्थ 'गुणा करना' है

दिया गया समीकरण: [{(23 × 15) - (2 ÷ 2)} + (2 - 4)] ÷ 2

आपस में बदलने के बाद व्यंजक बन जाता है:

= [{(23 - 15) + (2 × 2)} ÷ (2 + 4)] × 2

= [{8 + 4} ÷ 6] × 2

= [12 ÷ 6] × 2

= 2 × 2 = 4

दिया गया समीकरण: 36 - 5 ÷ 240 × 6 + 17 =?

दी गई शर्तें: यदि '+' का अर्थ '-' है, '-' का अर्थ '×' है, '×' का अर्थ '÷' है और '÷' का अर्थ '+' है

= 36 × 5 + 40 - 17

= 180 + 40 - 17

= 220 - 17 = 203

question:
Which of the following interchange in two mathematical operations will balance the question given below?

75 ÷ 15 × 8 + 14 - 5 = 67
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. - and ×.

Given Equation : 75 ÷ 15 × 8 + 14 - 5 =67

After interchanging signs in Option 3, the equation is satisfied:

75 ÷ 15 - 8 + 14 × 5 =67

5 - 8 + 14 × 5 = 67

5 - 8 + 70 = 67

70 - 3 = 67

67 = 67

question:
If A denotes ‘+’, B denotes ‘×’, C denotes ‘−’, and D denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

7 A 3 B 24 D 2 = 20 B ? A 3
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 2​​​​​.

Given conditions: A denotes ‘+’, B denotes ‘×’, C denotes ‘−’, and D denotes ‘÷’

Given equation: 7 A 3 B 24 D 2 = 20 B? A 3

After interchanging the expression becomes:

7 + 3 × 24 ÷ 2 = 20 × 2 + 3

7 + 3 × 12 = 40 + 3

7 + 36 = 43

43 = 43
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 2​​​​​​ है।

दी गई शर्तें: A, '+' को दर्शाता है, B, '×' को दर्शाता है, C, '-' को दर्शाता है, और D, '÷' को दर्शाता है

दिया गया समीकरण: 7 A 3 B 24 D 2 = 20 B? A 3

आपस में बदलने के बाद अभिव्यक्ति बन जाती है:

7 + 3 × 24 ÷ 2 = 20 × 2 + 3

7 + 3 × 12 = 40 + 3

7 + 36 = 43

43 = 43

question:
If A denotes ‘+’, B denotes ‘×’, C denotes ‘−’, and D denotes ‘÷’, then what will be the value of the following equation?

96 D 3 B 8 C 25 A 14 =?
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 245​​​​.

Given conditions: A denotes ‘+’, B denotes ‘×’, C denotes ‘−’, and D denotes ‘÷’

Given the equation: 96 D 3 B 8 C 25 A 14 =?

After interchanging the expression becomes:

= 96 ÷ 3 × 8 - 25 + 14

= 32 × 8 - 25 + 14

= 32 × 8 - 25 + 14

= 256 - 25 + 14 = 245
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 245 ​​​​​है।

दी गई शर्तें: A, '+' को दर्शाता है, B, '×' को दर्शाता है, C, '-' को दर्शाता है, और D, '÷' को दर्शाता है

दिया गया समीकरण: 96 D 3 B 8 C 25 A 14 =?

आपस में बदलने के बाद अभिव्यक्ति बन जाती है:

= 96 ÷ 3 × 8 - 25 + 14

= 32 × 8 - 25 + 14

= 32 × 8 - 25 + 14

= 256 - 25 + 14 = 245
